data.narrative:
Dynamo Air is a pre-seed stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Ethan Blagg, whose prior experience includes co-founding and leading Nexus Technologies. The valuation universe consists of 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs, representing 13 total data points across the sector.

Two standard triangulation methods were evaluated. Peer-median analysis proved inapplicable: while 14 same-sector pre-seed and adjacent-stage peers exist in Space & Aerospace, none formed a sufficiently narrow set of three or more comparables meeting stage and valuation-tier filters simultaneously, rendering sector-wide median anchoring unreliable. Public-comp anchoring also could not be applied; the Space & Aerospace sector median P/S multiple is 27.4x across the five public tickers, but this requires revenue data that private companies typically do not disclose and is not available for Dynamo Air.

Given the absence of applicable quantitative methods, this analysis cannot support a specific valuation range at this time. The primary uncertainty is the lack of revenue or financial metrics for the target, which precludes both relative valuation and marked-to-market techniques. Future valuation work requires either (1) disclosure of early-stage revenue or unit economics, or (2) identification of additional pre-seed Space & Aerospace comparables with disclosed funding terms. The founder's track record in technology and aerospace ventures represents qualitative context but does not substitute for financial anchors.
